name: bpic2019
title: BPIC2019 purchase-to-pay mapping pack
source: BPI Challenge 2019 purchase order handling event log
dataset_policy: The public dataset is not redistributed. Download it from the official source, then run import-xes or import-csv with --pack bpic2019.

flow_inference.three_way_gr_based: Goods Receipt=true and GR-Based Inv. Verif.=true
flow_inference.three_way_invoice_before_gr: Goods Receipt=true and GR-Based Inv. Verif.=false
flow_inference.consignment: Item Category or Document Type contains consignment

notes: Run once with --report, review unmapped activities, then rerun with --strict after the audit scope is fixed.
policy-template --flow-type auto uses BPIC2019 trace attributes to choose the replay policy type.
Vendor creates invoice is left unmapped by default because Record Invoice Receipt is the accounting evidence used by the replay oracle.
BPIC2019 does not expose the full PO or invoice approval workflow; use a high --approval-limit unless you supply approval evidence through a custom activity map.
